summary: V3 /experience funnel end-to-end frontend testing. Tested: /experience load + testids, UTM capture, intent selection (all 4 IDs), card draw, Scene 4 CTA redirect, analytics no-op without consent, WelcomeSplash (both personalized + generic fallback), skip button, primary/secondary CTA navigation, font preload, Register.js redirect logic (code review). 10/11 features PASS. 1 bug: experience-zodiac-shortcut fails to appear with ?utm_campaign=vierge due to useMemo/useEffect ordering.

ui_bugs.issue: experience-zodiac-shortcut is NOT rendered when arriving on /experience?utm_campaign=vierge. Root cause: detectZodiacCampaign() is called inside useMemo (runs during initial render) which reads utm from sessionStorage, but captureUtm() runs inside useEffect (after render). On first render sessionStorage is empty so zodiac=null and useMemo memoizes it forever. sessionStorage.exp_utm IS correctly persisted (verified) but the shortcut UI never appears.

action_items: Fix ExperienceRoot.jsx: compute zodiac reactively after captureUtm(). Option A: call captureUtm() synchronously during render (or before useMemo). Option B: read window.location.search directly in detectZodiacCampaign fallback. Option C: use useState + useEffect to set zodiac after captureUtm runs. Suggested: `const zodiac = useMemo(() => { captureUtm(); return detectZodiacCampaign(); }, []);` OR make detectZodiacCampaign parse window.location.search as fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: ExperienceRoot.jsx: race condition between useMemo(detectZodiacCampaign) and useEffect(captureUtm). Order of hooks means the memoized zodiac reads empty sessionStorage on first pass.
ExperienceRoot.jsx is ~450 lines with a lot of mixed concerns (scroll orchestration, timing, handlers, JSX). Consider splitting scene sections into subcomponents.
Register.js redirect to /mon-accueil?welcome=1 code path was verified by code review only (not e2e signup) — logic looks correct (lines 79-87).
WelcomeSplash uses inline style objects instead of the Tailwind/CSS system used elsewhere — inconsistent styling approach, but functional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V3 funnel is 91% working. Verified passes: experience-root visible, scene-1-cta, all 4 scene-2-choice-* IDs (relationship/clarity/self_discovery/specific_question), sessionStorage exp_intent='self_discovery' after click, sessionStorage exp_utm={utm_source:'test',utm_campaign:'vierge'} after ?utm_source=test&utm_campaign=vierge, scene-3-card-moon click sets exp_card='moon', scene-3-continue appears, scene-4-cta appears after ~18s dwell and redirects to /inscription?intent=self_discovery&exp_card=moon&utm_source=test&utm_campaign=vierge&welcome=1, experience-skip navigates to /, no fbq/gtag/dataLayer defined without consent (analytics silent no-op), WelcomeSplash renders with welcome-title='Et si nous commencions par votre ciel ?', welcome-primary-cta navigates to /services/theme-natal, welcome-secondary-cta available, welcome-skip removes ?welcome=1 from URL, welcome-splash-generic + welcome-dismiss render when no intent in sessionStorage, font preload for Playfair+Display present in index.html. FAIL: experience-zodiac-shortcut never appears due to useMemo-before-useEffect race. Registration full e2e signup not performed (multi-step wizard 1/7 with birth data etc), but Register.js code path verified via review.
rca of the issue: In ExperienceRoot.jsx: `const zodiac = useMemo(() => detectZodiacCampaign(), []);` on line 138 executes during React render. `useEffect(() => { captureUtm(); ... }, []);` on line 125 executes AFTER render commits. detectZodiacCampaign() reads from readUtm() which reads sessionStorage.exp_utm. Since captureUtm has not yet run on initial render, sessionStorage is empty, detectZodiacCampaign returns null, useMemo caches null forever. Reproduction: visit /experience?utm_campaign=vierge → sessionStorage.exp_utm is set correctly (visible in devtools) but [data-testid=experience-zodiac-shortcut] never appears. Mitigation: either (a) call captureUtm() inside the useMemo before detectZodiacCampaign, or (b) have detectZodiacCampaign read directly from window.location.search when sessionStorage is empty, or (c) convert to useState + useEffect after captureUtm.
